summary: A feeling you have struggled to explain may finally find language that another person can understand.
body: A feeling you have struggled to explain may finally find language that another person can understand. When Mercury sextiles Neptune, thought and intuition cooperate, making creative writing, emotional conversations, symbolism, music, and subtle observations easier to translate into something shareable. You do not have to strip all the feeling out of the message to make it clear. Anchor the abstract feeling to a concrete example so the other person has something real to grasp. Being deeply understood usually requires surgical precision in your language, not an endless explanation.
